name: io.github.koda-ai-studio/grc-lake
title: GRC Lake
description: Read-only connectors; local writes. Evidence and assessments for agents. Only people approve.

environmentVariables.name: GRC_LAKE_LAKE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local lake directory (default ./lake)

environmentVariables.name: GRC_LAKE_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: local, remote or auto (default); use remote on shared machines

environmentVariables.name: GRC_LAKE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: GRC Lake API URL for remote mode
